about_the_game: Mana Battle is a single-player strategy game where you build a guild of heroes on a 3x3 board. You face off against enemy guilds in automated battles until one side's morale is fully depleted. Heroes interact based on their position and battle roles — for example, some healers grow stronger when nearby allies heal, and certain tanks can shield your guild while boosting allies.
